nodes.name: Webhook: Quota Status Request
nodes.notes: GET /quota-status. Read-only endpoint behind the quota badge; it never changes a counter, it only reports them.

nodes.name: Extract Client IP
nodes.notes: Reads the caller's IP from $json.ip, falling back to the x-forwarded-for, x-real-ip and cf-connecting-ip headers, and checks its shape. Deletes the raw headers from the item right away so the address travels no further through the run than it has to.

nodes.name: IP Valid?
nodes.notes: Without an IP there is no counter to look up.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { error: "invalid_request", message: "Could not determine a valid client IP address for this request." } }}

nodes.name: Respond: 400 Invalid IP
nodes.notes: 400 with { error: 'invalid_request' }, the error shape recipe-generator.service.ts expects.

nodes.name: Build & Sign Firestore JWT
nodes.notes: Signs an RS256 service-account assertion for the datastore scope. Hand-written because n8n has no Google service-account credential for the Firestore REST API. normalizePemKey repairs the line breaks that get lost when the private key is pasted into the Set node.

nodes.name: Exchange JWT for Access Token
nodes.notes: Trades the signed assertion at oauth2.googleapis.com for an access token valid for one hour. Needs no n8n credential - the assertion is the proof of identity.

nodes.name: Store Access Token
nodes.notes: Carries access_token on as accessToken, together with the fields from the JWT step, so every later Firestore call can read it by node name.

nodes.name: Compute Quota Keys
nodes.notes: Hashes the IP exactly as the generation workflow does, so both address the same documents. Throws when the salt is missing or shorter than 16 characters - an unsalted hash of an IPv4 address is brute-forced in seconds.

nodes.name: Read IP Quota Counter
nodes.notes: GET on quota_ip/<ipDocId>. 'Never Error' is on: before the first generation of the day the document does not exist, and that 404 simply counts as 0.

nodes.name: Read Global Quota Counter
nodes.notes: The same for quota_total/<date>, the shared daily counter.

nodes.name: Build Status Response
nodes.notes: Turns the two counts into ipRemaining (3 per IP) and totalRemaining (12 across all users), clamped at 0.

nodes.name: Respond: 200 Success
nodes.notes: 200 with { ipRemaining, totalRemaining }, the QuotaStatus shape from quota.service.ts.

nodes.name: Set Service Account Credentials
nodes.notes: Same service account as the generation workflow. quotaIpSalt has to be identical there and here, otherwise this endpoint reads a different document than the one being counted up.
